requirements.title: Responsive first-person movement
requirements.acceptance: Implement walk sprint crouch jump dive and low vault; traverse the approved placement fixture without snagging.

requirements.title: Immediate controlled respawn
requirements.acceptance: Lethal damage starts one short pull-back and return camera sequence. The falling corpse is visible; control returns at the protected start in at most 1.2 seconds without a level reload. This user-directed death presentation supersedes the earlier 150 ms target.

requirements.title: Reliable persistent construction
requirements.acceptance: Every death leaves a visible body in the loaded scene across later lives and manual retries. After its short physics presentation, committed corpse collision and pose remain unchanged through later deaths and impacts; no age/count eviction.

requirements.title: Placement changes the route
requirements.acceptance: One to three well-placed bodies alter a demonstrated route; six of eight observed new players deliberately place and exploit one.

requirements.title: Supported traversable body geometry
requirements.acceptance: No unsupported or wall-crossing placement; repeated fixture placement varies by no more than 0.15 m.

requirements.title: Consistent cover and occlusion
requirements.acceptance: Stable proxies block player movement baseline fire and threat sight consistently with visible silhouettes.

requirements.title: Continuous siege across death
requirements.acceptance: Threat timers objectives gates weapon state and active clock continue through pawn replacement.

requirements.title: Atomic captured checkpoints
requirements.acceptance: One surviving completed capture atomically disables threats opens its gate and advances spawn; same-frame lethal damage cancels capture.

requirements.title: Combat creates movement opportunities
requirements.acceptance: Three sensor hits within one second suppress for four seconds; hits cannot indefinitely refresh suppression; controls disable permanently.

requirements.title: Recoverable sector and run reset
requirements.acceptance: Sector reset restores entry state marks assisted and retains all-run time and deployments; fresh run clears the siege only after confirmation.

requirements.title: Time and result classification
requirements.acceptance: Pause and loading exclude active time; local records separate rules content and uninterrupted resumed or assisted runs.

requirements.title: Durable compatible save and resume
requirements.acceptance: Save round trip restores stable world and relative timers; interruption and corruption recover previous complete generation without silent overwrite.

requirements.title: Finite construction cost with unlimited lives
requirements.acceptance: Tile and visual caps bound cost; 1000 deaths reach a memory plateau while useful collision stays intact.

requirements.title: Readable death and placement feedback
requirements.acceptance: Newest useful body and rejected placement are distinguishable without color alone; feedback does not delay control.

requirements.title: Coherent photorealistic presentation and audio
requirements.acceptance: Representative sector demonstrates body silhouette alignment realistic materials meaningful threat cues and music continuity across respawns.

requirements.title: Accessible input and presentation
requirements.acceptance: Core flow works with rebound keys and controller; comfort subtitle reduced-gore and redundant threat cues preserve gameplay.

requirements.title: Complete bounded fortress content
requirements.acceptance: Three linked sectors three controls two gates one rifle and two fixed threat variants support a complete start-to-victory run.

requirements.title: Local measurement and playtest evidence
requirements.acceptance: Versioned events link life body use checkpoint and timing; observation distinguishes intent from incidental use.

requirements.title: Reproducible build and review workflow
requirements.acceptance: Exact environment binary workflow benchmark manifest and clean-checkout packaged build recipe are recorded. Editor setup rejects missing inputs and version mismatches, preserves caller configuration, separates rendered and headless execution, and proves a successful Python commandlet plus localhost MCP discovery and a reversible editor operation.

requirements.title: Release recovery and support readiness
requirements.acceptance: Candidate install upgrade save compatibility rollback path credits and support package are reviewed with a named release owner.

requirements.title: Versioned validated configuration
requirements.acceptance: Gameplay values have one versioned source and invalid transforms bounds references or cap relationships fail validation.

requirements.title: Evidence based production gates
requirements.acceptance: Each milestone records actual build evidence defects decisions and go revise or stop outcome.

requirements.title: Resources survive death without reload exploit
requirements.acceptance: Magazine reserve reload and fire cadence persist across death; checkpoint and timed resupply prevent ammunition softlocks.

requirements.title: Persistent settings and localization readiness
requirements.acceptance: Settings survive new runs; UI strings are externalized and pseudo-localized core screens remain readable.

requirements.title: Runnable turret approach first slice
requirements.acceptance: A standalone Windows build launches into a lit first-person approach. WASD and mouse move/look, Shift sprints and Space jumps. A fixed turret acquires visible in-range players, telegraphs, fires bounded bursts and damages on first blocking hit only. Cover prevents damage, spawn is safe, lethal damage resets to spawn once, and movement, aiming, recoil, hit feedback and generated sound are observable. Invalid time or tuning is rejected; large frame steps never emit unbounded shots. Package includes prerequisites instructions and launch script.

requirements.title: Persistent ragdoll death and return camera
requirements.acceptance: Each lethal life creates exactly one articulated physics corpse. Camera pulls back to show the fall and returns to protected first-person control within 1.2 s. All older bodies remain visible and solid across later lives and R retries. Freeze the visible pose into separate stable collision before control returns. Duplicate hits/retry during death do not duplicate corpses or restart the camera. Invalid simulation deltas do not mutate death progress; completion emits once. Validate two real deaths, physics motion, stable old transforms, corpse visibility/occlusion, camera view target, controls and packaged rendered/audio output.
